title: Fragment four: the copy
subtitle: A holo recording, three hundred years old
author: dubbed to tape by Lt. Shepard

lines.text: DUBBED FROM HOLO -- FRAGMENT FOUR OF SIX
The chair again. He is older. He speaks slowly now.
Four. I copied it.
Not her. Not only her. I want to be exact about this.
I took the valley. The river, and the bend in it.
The falls where the boats had to stop. The escarpment.
The salt licks. The hunting country. The weather.
And I put it on a world in a similar orbit, far away.
Where nobody was fighting over anything at all.
And the people. I copied the people on it. Everyone.
The ones who would have died in the raids, and her.
He holds up a hand, as if somebody has interrupted.
I know. I know what that is. I have thought of little else.
They were not copies to themselves. They woke up.
They were hungry and cold and arguing, like people.
They were people. They are people. I did not make them.
I made the ground they stand on. That is all.
I owe them something. I do not know what it is.
Perhaps only to leave them alone. So I tried that.
-- FRAGMENT FOUR ENDS --
